expression.type.string.substr: Take a slice of the string.
The first variant slice from the provided position all the way to the end. The second variant slice from the 2 provided start and end positions respectively.
expression.type.string.trim: Remove whitespaces from both ends of the string.
expression.type.string.trimStart: Remove whitespaces from the start of the string.
expression.type.string.trimEnd: Remove whitespaces from the end of the string.
expression.type.string.padStart: Insert characters at the start of the string until the length equals to provided number.
The first variant insert the spaces. The second variant repeats the pattern provided in second parameter.
expression.type.string.padEnd: Insert characters at the end of the string until the length equals to provided number.
The first variant insert the spaces. The second variant repeats the pattern provided in second parameter.
expression.type.boolean: A value that have 2 states: either true or false.
expression.type.vec2: Swizzling is allowed by using a combination of 'x' and 'y', such as 'v.yx' to reverse the vector, or 'v.xxx' to create 3D vector.
expression.type.vec3: Swizzling is allowed by using a combination of 'x', 'y' and 'z', such as 'v.zyx' to reverse the vector, or 'v.xy' to create 2D vector.
expression.type.length: Get the length of a vector.
expression.type.cross: Calculate cross product of 2 three-dimension vectors.
expression.type.rgb: Convert red, green and blue values to 3D vector respective to the parameters. Each channel is clamped between 0 and 255.
expression.type.hsl: Convert hue (0 to 360), saturation (0 to 1) and lightness (0 to 1) to 3D vector.
